input_isolation: Neutral source/case IDs; family/insertion/positive truth stays outside retrieval inputs

construction.primitive: evaluation.rendering.render_tone and mix; familiar procedural mechanisms
construction.performance: Independent seeds, detuning +/-0.13 semitone, spectral slope +/-0.04, FM ratio +/-0.02 and cutoff +/-35Hz; multiplicative independent slow amplitude modulation
construction.negative: Same mechanism, slope+1.3, FM ratio+.67, cutoff+2200Hz; proxy identity, not human irrelevance
construction.absent: Query slope+2.4, FM ratio+1.7, cutoff+6000Hz; no matching preset in candidates
construction.background: Independent 3rd-order 1800Hz low-pass noise RMS .04 plus .01*sin(127Hz) and .008*sin(331Hz); no shared query realization
construction.stereo: Left mono mixture, right .7 mixture plus .01 independent noise; resample_poly 24k to44.1k
construction.exact_controls: Declared candidate original is the query parent; its duplicate group must be excluded
construction.audit: Independent algebraic mixture/level reconstruction, full PCM/hash, lag/native endpoint and silence/clipping checks

revision.reason: Compare shipped event-multi unchanged; no tuning dimension

metrics.matching: one-to-one maximum cardinality then IoU; actual scored representatives only
metrics.primary: Macro by declared mechanism family and condition; paired cases retained
metrics.absent: Forced ranking validity and score/order only; no rejection threshold

controls.random: independent seeded permutation per case, same eligible population

decision: Complete valid compliant outputs; no macro group-hit@1 or IoU event-recall@10 loss; strict gain in at least one; no newly lost per-case positive-group coverage@20. Apply to development and confirmation separately; preserve condition regressions.

product_cases.scope: Real import/save/submit/status/result and frozen model; both arms; included in initial development executions

playable_rule: Three product cases, plus first development primary baseline IoU miss at ten: first highest-ranked retained native representative for a known-positive group; if no known-positive group is ranked, first actual result. No quality-based replacement.
evidence_limits: Prospective confirmation within familiar mechanisms; no human agreement, new A06 holdout, Loulou layer truth or unseen musical-source claim
